name: Real-Debrid
description: Resolves links of other hosters through a Real-Debrid account.

account.secret_hint: Pick how this account signs in. Connect with a code is the simple way: save the account, press Connect and confirm the code it shows at real-debrid.com/device — no username, no token to copy, and rDownloader keeps the sign-in renewed. API token takes the private token from real-debrid.com/apitoken instead.
account.secret_hint_api_key: Open real-debrid.com/apitoken (signed in), copy the private API token and enter it here. No username is needed. If you renew the token there, enter the new one here.
account.secret_hint_oauth: Nothing to enter here. Save the account and press Connect: rDownloader shows an address and a code, you confirm the code at real-debrid.com/device, and the account stays signed in from then on.

codes.realdebrid.auth_invalid: The Real-Debrid sign-in or API token is no longer valid. Connect the account again, or enter the current token from real-debrid.com/apitoken.
codes.realdebrid.file_offline: Real-Debrid reports this file as unavailable
codes.realdebrid.host_unsupported: Real-Debrid does not support this host for this account
codes.realdebrid.ip_not_allowed: Real-Debrid does not allow this account from this address
codes.realdebrid.limit_reached: Real-Debrid reports the traffic or hoster limit as reached
codes.realdebrid.no_download_url: Real-Debrid did not return a download link
codes.realdebrid.rate_limited: The Real-Debrid API rate limit was reached. Waiting.
codes.realdebrid.server_busy: Real-Debrid or the hoster behind it is temporarily unavailable
codes.realdebrid.token_missing: This Real-Debrid account is not connected yet, or has no API token entered
